lines: Aur bazaar se le aaye agar toot gaya
Saaghar-e-Jam se mera jaam-e-sifaal achha hai
couplets.en: I prefer my clay cup to Jamshid's goblet, for if it breaks I can buy another in the bazaar.

lines: Unke dekhe se jo aa jaati hai munh par raunaq
Woh samajhte hain ki beemaar ka haal achha hai
couplets.en: The sight of her brings color to my face, and she takes it for a sign that I am getting better.

lines: Dekhiye paate hain ushshaaq buton se kya faiz
couplets.en: Let us see what favor lovers receive from their idols.

lines: Dekhiye paate hain ushshaaq buton se kya faiz
Ik barahman ne kaha hai ki ye saal achha hai
couplets.en: Let us see what favor lovers receive from their idols, now that a Brahmin has foretold a good year.

lines: Ik barahman ne kaha hai ki ye saal achha hai
couplets.en: A Brahmin has foretold a good year.

lines: Hum ko maaloom hai jannat ki haqeeqat lekin
couplets.en: We know the truth about paradise, though.

lines: Hum ko maaloom hai jannat ki haqeeqat lekin
Dil ke khush rakhne ko, Ghalib, ye khayaal achha hai
couplets.en: We know the truth about paradise, Ghalib, though the thought of it still comforts the heart.
